اعتبرنا (form VIII)
# اِعْتَبَرْنَا (iʕtabarnā) /iʕ.ta.bar.naː/: first-person plural past active of اِعْتَبَرَ (iʕtabara)
# اُعْتُبِرْنَا (uʕtubirnā) /uʕ.tu.bir.naː/: first-person plural past passive of اِعْتَبَرَ (iʕtabara)
